items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Danny Logan had the band. So we'd be -- we'd go up there.

ctx.x: When I first met Tiny, he was up— let's see, what is the name of this little place up off the state line off Pennsylvania -- upstate New York. I think it was close to Erie, Pennsylvania, and we were up there on a three nights gig playing for -- the circus had a tent, kids, you know, all the people would come in, and Danny Logan had the band. So we'd be -- we'd go up there.
